name: Your Hook Name
description: Describe what this hook does and when to use it. This template shows all available trigger types and configurations.

then.prompt: Your agent instructions here. The agent will execute these instructions when the hook triggers.

available_trigger_types: fileSaved - triggers when a file matching the pattern is saved
promptSubmit - triggers before a user prompt is processed
agentStop - triggers after the agent completes a task
preTaskExecution - triggers before a spec task starts executing
preToolUse - triggers before a tool is invoked (use toolTypes to filter)
userTriggered - triggers only when manually invoked by the user
available_action_types: askAgent - sends the prompt to the agent for execution
pattern_examples: src/**/*.java - all Java files under src/
tips: Set enabled to false while testing
Keep prompts focused on a single concern
Reference steering files for large context instead of inlining
Use specific file patterns to avoid unnecessary triggers
